purpose: Execute only a preflight-ready propose_revision dispatch request against the caller-provided ResolutionRevisionChain and return a deterministic execution receipt correlated to the originating dispatch request.

semantics.preflight: preflight_revision_dispatch_executor must report request_ready=true and executor_ready=true immediately before mutation

transaction.simulation: executor preflight first proves acceptance on a cloned ResolutionRevisionChain
transaction.rollback_snapshot: the actual adapter clones the caller-owned chain before mutation
transaction.commit: canonical open_revision succeeds and postconditions match the simulated revision id and expected revision-count delta
transaction.rollback: if canonical execution errors after preflight or postconditions mismatch, the caller-owned chain is restored from the clone

receipt.receipt_fingerprint: fnv1a64 over request/intent/dispatch identity + lineage + committed revision id + before/after revision counts
receipt.fingerprint_security: deterministic correlation only; not cryptographic integrity, authentication, authorization, or capability

scope.reason: this adapter owns only the locally modeled ResolutionRevisionChain mutation boundary

invariants: the adapter cannot execute a request whose current request preflight is closed
the adapter cannot execute unless revision executor preflight is ready against the same chain state
the adapter never infers authorization from executor_ready
explicit caller invocation is the execution trigger
the adapter calls the existing canonical ResolutionRevisionChain.open_revision authority
a successful call creates exactly one revision
replay of the same request is rejected by current executor state and creates no second revision
postcondition mismatch rolls back the caller-owned chain
the receipt preserves request_fingerprint and dispatch_fingerprint correlation
external review and runtime verifier execution remain outside this adapter
future_extensions: execution receipt rejoin as typed runtime/response evidence
caller authorization token or policy binding if revision mutation later requires stronger authority semantics
runtime verifier execution adapters after real handle binding
